label: FIND YOUR CLARITY #01
title: Why Is Pakistan Behind? Pakistanis are Hypocrites?
seo_title: Why Is Pakistan Behind? | Find Your Clarity #01 | Muffled Minds
seo_description: Babur Ayub on why Pakistan is behind: not talent or resources, but corruption, hypocrisy and lost ethics, and what one Pakistani can change.

guest.name: Babur Ayub
bio: Babur Ayub has 25+ years of leadership experience in Pakistan's retail and fashion industry, including Chenone, Hang Ten, Servis Group, Imperial Stores, Khas Stores and Onieo.

He is a lecturer at STEP IADM, a startup mentor, and the author of "Management by Qur'an". He appears in Find Your Clarity, the short-episode series by Muffled Minds in which each episode takes one big question everyone is confused about and looks for clarity.

summary: In the first episode of Find Your Clarity, host Khawar Shahzad and Babur Ayub take up the question every Pakistani asks: why is Pakistan behind? Babur Ayub argues that Pakistan is not behind at all in talent, resources or achievements, and that the real problem is moral decline: corruption, lying and hypocrisy, while vested interests capture the benefit that should reach the common man.

The episode goes back to 1947 and through the turning points Babur Ayub remembers, from the early years and the nationalisation of industry under Bhutto to the years since, and tests the question against everyday life: the common man is not prosperous, professionalism is missing in offices, and demagogues win votes with emotional stories while deliverables are never discussed. He contrasts this with nations that have fewer resources but no corruption, and with his own story of rising from a common man with no recommendation to country head and general manager.

It closes on ethics and literacy: morality and ethics begin at home, not in religion alone, and Pakistan's literacy rate, 63% and the lowest in South Asia according to the guest, counts people as literate if they can write their name, while educated people behave without ethics. The answer the episode leaves is that each person has to play their own role, starting with honesty and hard work.
we_discuss: What does behind really mean? Pakistan is not behind, it has morally declined
Is the common man happy in Pakistan?
Professionalism in Pakistan: bureaucracy vs industry
Talent or poor management: what is really missing?
We need to learn ethics: morality starts at home
Pakistan's literacy rate and what literacy really means
Playing your own role: what one ordinary Pakistani can change
takeaways: Pakistan has not fallen behind, it has morally deteriorated and become corrupt, while it has everything: seasons, minerals and resources.
A country is prosperous when the common man is prosperous, and the common man in Pakistan is not prosperous.
We are hypocrites: we lie, and fake news spreads because there is no institute teaching us how to filter information.
Professionalism means handling the common people's matters between arriving on time and leaving on time, and in industry it means delivering results, not working unpaid overtime.
Corruption is corruption, and a lie is a lie, whether small or big; only a lie told to save a life may be excused.
Morality and ethics have nothing to do with religion alone: they start with upbringing at home, and even countries with no religion punish corruption severely.
Leaving everything to Allah's will is not the answer: Allah gave us a brain, a body and senses, and Japan builds earthquake-proof buildings instead of accepting that houses fall.
Literacy is not writing your name: it is speaking well and giving presentations, and educated people without ethics behave like the uneducated.
In short, we have to play our role, and the higher management has to play its role.

transcript.text: Assalam-o-Alaikum everyone, welcome to Muffled Minds. I am your host Khawar. Viewers, aaj se hum ek nayi series start karne ja rahe hain, jis ka naam hoga Find Your Clarity. Hum ek nayi series jo hai, woh start karne ja rahe hain, Find Your Clarity. Hum topic par baad mein aayenge. First of all, I want to know your opinion about this Find Your Clarity phrase.

Bada woh hai, deep question hai. Jitna marzi aap understand karne ki koshish karein, clarity to, woh jaise kehte hain na, ke life is not a puzzle to be solved, it is a mystery to be believed. So nowhere you can find absolute clarity. We just need to have, I think, the clarity to that extent, jiske andar hamare kaam ho sakein, jismein hum peace ke saath, agar ek mulk ki baat karein, us mulk mein hum reh rahe hain, to humein itni clarity chahiye ke jismein honesty ke saath cheezein execute ho rahi hain. If I am paying my taxes,

if I am fulfilling all other responsibilities which are due on me, and if the regulatory authority and the government, they are using, utilizing those funds in the right direction, I think that clarity is more important for me to, you know, be able to live with peace that, okay, ke fine, I am not being cheated. Isi tarah aap agar education ke field mein jaate hain, to aapko kya clarity chahiye? The institute I am studying in, and they claim that they have the accreditation with certain

foreign university, and you are always curious to know about whether they have the document to support their claim, ke waqai inki accreditation hui bhi hai ya nahi bhi, for continuously, for 2 years or 4 years, till the time you stay in that university. You are doubtful unless you see that final document, that yes, they are recognized by the concerned authorities here in Pakistan, and they have been offered some accreditation or some awards by the foreign university they are claiming that they are affiliated with.

Aap ne achha kiya, yeh matlab discuss kar liya. Aaj ka jo hamara topic hai, woh bhi isi ke around hai. Episode one mein hum discuss karenge why Pakistan is behind, and what you can do about it. So hum discussion ko yahin se continue karte hain. So, jab se Pakistan bana, 1947, tab se leke aaj tak, till 2026, aapko kya lagta hai ke koi ek aisi cheez, jiski wajah se hum, baaki agar hum, agar hum Asian countries ki baat karein, unse hum peeche kyun reh gaye hain? Honestly speaking, based on my experience, what I have spent on my time,

or what I have studied and what I have seen, there is a big contradiction. So, we are raising this question because we have studied it. Humne iske baare mein padha hai, bohat zyada padha hai. Bohat zyada literature aisa float hota hai, aajkal to social media ka zamana hai, to from different platforms, you keep getting mixed emotions from the people, some are against the existence of this country, some are in favor of the existence. Meri nazar mein agar main isko dekhoon, aur agar aap hakeekat mein bhi isko dekhein, calculate kar lein, ke Pakistan peeche nahin hai. Nineteen fifty-six mein aapke mulk se ek group of scientists ne space shuttle kar di, us waqt India ne nahin ki thi, 1956.

To aap kis zamane mein space age mein jaane ki koshish kar rahe the? Agar aap dekhein, jab Pakistan bana, to ek sugar mill thi yahan par, Rawali sugar mill. Ab aap dekhein ke sugar mill ki taadaad kitni hai, woh alag baat hai ke woh sugar mafia bhi uske saath create ho gayi hai. Lekin you, you name the area, jo Bhutto sahab ki woh jo nationalisation ki policy thi, usse pehle agar aap dekhein to yahan pe Fiat ka, yahan pe aur kitni Ford ke yahan pe manufacturing plants lage hue the. They were producing cars, trucks, buses in Pakistan. To ab kya hua unka? Nationalise hua jab hum Bhutto ki regime mein, to matlab, government ki us waqt ki policy hogi, unka khayal hoga ke yeh

hum nationalise karenge, government usko control karegi, government ke paas revenues zyada aayenge, mulk ko revenues ki zaroorat hai, military ko strong karna hai, whatever. But us mein bohat saari aisi flourishing industry jo ke grow kar rahi thi, woh government ke control mein aane ke baad aahista aahista khatm hoti gayi, isliye ke us mein jab tak, jab tak woh log jo entrepreneurs hain, jo risk takers hain, when they are not involved in the process, in, because they have the interest to earn money, to earn profits, and they invest their energies, their capital, their lives into that project.

So when they own it, they think differently. So government, when you look at this thing, it is in a different perspective. In this way, if you go to the era, whatever regime came here, governments came here, different, there is no development, no advancement in Pakistan that has happened in Pakistan, Pakistan ko kisi na kisi jagah par noticeable country ke taur par saamne rakha hai duniya mein. Achha, main, I am not exactly denying your question. Baat yeh hai ke jo hum samajhte hain ke Pakistan peeche kyun reh gaya hai, kya yeh humne padha hai ya isko hum experience kar rahe hain? Achha, main, ek mulk jo hai woh khushhal tab hota hai jab ek aam aadmi jo hai woh khushhal ho. Since I am a common man, so mujhe nahin lagta ke aam aadmi khushhal hai.

Dekhiye, ab yeh bhi aapki observation par depend karta hai. Aap bazaar chale jayein. Kisi bhi bazaar mein chale jayein. Woh aapko fruit ki rediyan nazar aayengi. Aapko mazdoor nazar aayenge. Aapko chips bechne wale log nazar aayenge, bachon ki cheezein bech rahe hain. Aapko dekhein, kaun aadmi farigh hai? Koi aadmi farigh nahin hai. Baat yeh hai, coming back to your original generic question, hum peeche nahin reh gaye, hum morally deteriorate kar gaye hain, hum corrupt ho gaye hain. Hamare paas sab kuchh maujood hai, including jaise hum kehte hain ke kudrat ne humein seasons saare diye hue hain, jo minerals saare diye hue hain, resources saare diye hue hain, to hum usko explore bhi kar rahe hain, usko utilize bhi kar rahe hain, but there are vested interests ke kuchh log jinhon ne ek cartels create kiye aur phir woh us par control le gaye, jaise sugar mafia ka maine zikar kiya, to mafia bani jab to

woh saara benefit unke paas chala jata hai, and it is not in true spirit transferred to the common man. Baat yeh hai ke hum taraqqi karne ke baawjood, apne andar clarity nahin la sake, woh clarity jo aap poochh rahe the. Hum hypocrites hain, hum jhoot bolte hain. Ab hum jhoot bolne mein kuchh bhi announce kar sakte hain, social media pe aake. Aaj hum kitni fake news ka saamna karte hain, how to filter that? There is no institute in Pakistan which is telling you how to filter from the blind flow of information,

the right thing. How can you filter out the right thing? So, baat yeh hai ke hum jo bhi experience kar rahe hain, if it is our subjective experience, we should try to understand ke main bhi ek aam aadmi hoon, lekin maine padha, ek qualification li, uske baad main ek struggling phase mein gaya. I tried my level best to be successful in my entrepreneurial experiments, somehow I failed. I joined a company and main logon ko batata hoon ke jitna miraculously maine usme grow kiya hai,

ke main kisi company mein country head lag gaya, phir maine switch kiya, to doosri company mein country head lag gaya, phir maine switch kiya, phir kisi company mein general manager lag gaya, and I am a common man. Mere paas koi sifarish aisi nahin hai. Aap apna poora talent aur poori ability aur poori expertise aur poori spirits ke saath aap apne aap ko utilize hi nahin karte, as a human being, as a citizen of Pakistan. Jab aap poora potential nahin denge and complain karte rahenge har waqt ke yeh cheez nahin mili, woh cheez nahin mili, to aap progress ko kis tarah, kin terms mein progress ko measure karenge? Measure karne ke liye aapke paas yahi tools reh jayenge ke usne mujhe bataya tha, aisa hai, yeh to peeche reh gaye hain. Usne mujhe bataya tha, yaar yeh to jang haar gaye hain.

Usne mujhe bataya tha, inke paas to paise nahin hain. Wahi aapki undocumented economy kitni zyada hai, aapko pata hai? Aapka jo audited companies hain, uski base pe aapka budget banta hai, lekin jo un-audited aapki income hai, mulki, woh to usmein shamil hi nahin hai, poori total aapki. I mean we should try to correct ourselves. We have progressed, we have achieved a lot, not only in the industrial sector but also the agricultural sector. We are still number three in the cotton production,

we are probably number two in the rice exports, we are self-sufficient in a way, ke hamare paas agricultural base itni strong hai ke hamare mulk mein kisi na kisi tarah se sab ko khana mil raha hai. Lekin baat woh hai na, ke ek question aata hai, ke kya sirf humne khana khana hai? Kya hum khana khane ke liye paida hue hain, ya hamara koi haq nahin hai ke hum is se aage badhein? To unfortunately, jab hum isse aage ki baat karte hain, khaali khane ki, to hum uske baad kisi achhe khane ka hi sochte hain. Hum kisi achhi manzil par pahunchne ka nahin sochte hain. Hum agar aaj kehte hain ke hum to daal kha ke bade hue hain, to hamara agla khwab kya hota hai? Ke yaar, main agar mere paas paise hon to main us hotel mein ja ke khana khaun. To matlab everything

is revolving around food. To correct karein apne targets ko, correct karein apne objectives ko, karein achhe khwab dekhein, aur in cheezon ko measure karna shuru karein, in cheezon ko experience karna shuru karein ke aapke mulk mein motorway jab bani thi to woh duniya ki shayad teesri motorway thi us waqt, not sure, yeh South Asia ke andar woh pehli thi. Par jab fiber optics aapke mulk mein aaya tha, to us waqt bhi aap teesre ya chauthe mulk the duniya mein, duniya mein. Doosron se upar, mulkon ke beech mein aap woh the. To aap kaise keh sakte hain ke haan, yeh hamari khaamiyan zaroor hain ke hum corrupt hain, hum jhoot bolte hain, hum munafiq hain. Ab aap dekhein ke yeh, yeh jin nations mein resources bhi kam hain,

national resources bhi kam hain, human resources bhi kam hain, human capital bhi kam hain, wahan pe corruption nahin hai, hypocrisy nahin hai, and they are progressing. To this is how I think we should try to change the lens, to look at the things, and should be able to, I mean, go deeper, deeper and deeper into the truth and reality. Now you are talking about hypocrisy, so what if I ask you to rate Pakistan in terms of professionalism out of 10? Dekhiye, professionalism ke to jo mayaar ya jo protocols set kiye hue hain, British government, jab yahan pe woh the, angrez the, to unhon ne ek set kiya, bureaucracy ke andar ek professionalism ki different definition hai.

Industrial aur manufacturing area ke andar professionalism ki definition different hai. They hired you, they created that civil servants institute where you could be able to rule the people. Whereas the actual objective of that position is to serve the people. So the protocols are different from professionalism. No matter if you wake up early in the morning, you be on your seat exactly at the given time, which is your schedule, and you leave exactly at the right time. But between these two extremes of the day,

you are supposed to handle matters related to the common people, and if they are solved, you are called a professional. But if you talk about industrialization, and you talk about industrialism, and you talk about professionalism, then yes, we lack a lot of many things. Hum overtime lagwate hain, uske paise nahin dete. Hum kehte hain ke yaar 5:00 baje subah, 8:00 baje, 9:00 baje aa jao, aur shaam ko 5:00 baje chhutti ka time hai. Nahin yaar, koi masla nahin hai. You want to grow, you want to achieve something. Do you have some targets?

To banda uske jawab mein na nahin keh sakta, to usko kehte hain, tum 2 ghante aur lagao, you will find more avenues to see the progress in your personal career. So, yeh exactly in terms of the industrial background and the bureaucratic background. Aur aap dekhein na, aapke mulk mein sab se zyada professional kaun hai? Army. Haan, no doubt hai na. To ab army, woh humein achhe nahin lagte. Hum aksar mauqon pe keh dete hain ke yaar, aise professional ka humne kya karna hai? To yaar phir aapne aisi non-professional, cheap cheezon ka kya karna hai, jin ki wajah se aapki munafqat phail rahi hai, jhoot phail raha hai? peeche aapse vote bhi lete hain, uske peeche aapko naare bhi lagwate hain, aur kehte hain ke hum yeh create kar denge, hum woh create kar denge. To in reality you need professionalism, you need the ground reality in terms of deliverables. Ke agar aap koi kaam kar rahe hain to uske deliverables kya hain? Jab ke hum log bade jazbaati log hain. Hum deliverables ki baat nahin karte. Hum kehte hain political leader zinda hai, aur koi political leader hamara murshid hai, aur koi kuchh hai, to hum use hi pe zinda rehna chahte hain. We are not taking anything serious in terms of improving our economy,

in terms of improving our moral behavior, our morality, everything. So, mujhe aise lagta hai ke saari cheezein government ne nahin padhani thi aapko. Saara kuchh aapko government ne schoolon mein nahin padhana tha. Jis waqt aap bade ho gaye hain, aapko sense aa gayi hai, to aap, you are not forced to study only the book which is prescribed to you. You have a free mind, you have the freedom to think. You can compare between what is right and what is wrong, and you can find your own way, which is not contradicting with the law, but at least can create some kind of ease in your life, or in the life of your family, or in the life of your community, and all that. So I think we should try to see this. I think that you can add something in your genes,

for example, main kisi bhi ek sector ki example, for example, sports ki hum example lein, to cricket, kyunke Pakistan mein jo hai woh sab se zyada sports jo hai wohi dekhi jati hai, and then hockey, jiska bura hi haal hai. But cricket ki agar hum example lein, aur hum apni neighbour country se usko compare karein, to aapko kya lagta hai ke jo baaki countries ka standard hai, woh kya hamara standard hai? Main shuru se sunta aa raha hoon ke yaar Pakistan mein achhe bowlers jo hain na, woh hote hain. We don't have batsmen in Pakistan. As compared to India, there are good batsmen, bowlers, not so much. But we were just one of them.

But hum to pehle ek hi the na. To aapko kya lagta hai ke hum kahan pe jo hai woh lag kar rahe hain? Aur main ek aur cheez add kar doon. Aap ne bhi kaha na ke har cheez government ne nahin aapko sikhani. But humein us track par to laya ja sakta hai, jo higher management hai, uski taraf government ne ek direction to deni hai na, apna qibla theek rakhna hai, taaki awaam ka qibla bhi theek ho. Woh kaam karna hai, jiski wajah se woh role model banein aur log unko follow karein, woh to karna hai. Ab cricket ka bada simple answer hai, uska hum baat kar chuke hain, ke hum peeche nahin reh gaye, hum corrupt hain. Cricket mein bhi corruption hai, aur kya hai, favouritism hai, nepotism hai. Itna artistically ab hum cheezon ko karte hain ke hum agar corruption kar rahe hain to woh corruption nazar nahin aati. To we have to be very good actors. Ke hum agar woh

hypocrisy hai, ke hum agar koi kaam jhoot bhi bolna hai humne, to usko is tarah se dramatize karenge, is tarah se facts and figures present karenge ke woh jhoot aapko sach ki shakal mein nazar aana shuru ho jayega, believable thing. So I mean yeh bhi human mind ki sharpness hai. This is the astute brain's product ke aap kitne haazir dimaag hain, kitne zabardast analytical expert hain, kitne zabardast comparative analysis ke maahir hain ke aap jab koi galat baat bhi karte hain, uske kai zehni cheezon mein, uske upar woh layers hoti hain, multiple layered koi statement aap jaari kar dete hain, jiske real meanings kuchh aur hote hain, but in reality we will have to accept that corruption has been legalised in our country.

Hum yeh nahin keh sakte ke yeh chhoti corruption hai to isko maaf kar do, yeh badi corruption hai to isko pakad lo. Corruption is corruption. Corruption is corruption. Jhoot hai to woh chhota ya bada nahin hai, woh jhoot hi hai. Haan, yaar, agar aapko kisi ki zindagi bachane ke liye jhoot bolna pad raha hai, kisi ko najaiz ziyaati se bachane ke liye jhoot bolna pad raha hai, to uski to shayad aap gunjaish nikaal sakte hain, ke aapki soul burden nahin hogi usse, ke aapke dimaag par aur zehen par uska asar rahe ke yaar maine kuchh jurm kar diya. Lekin aisa jhoot ya aisi corruption jisse hazaaron log mar jayein, hazaaron log bimaar ho jayein, hazaaron log ki income affect ho jayein, woh saari ki saari to ek criminal act ke taur par dekhi jaani chahiye. To cricket mein bhi yeh hai, hockey

mein bhi. Hockey mein aap, ek aisa zamana tha jis waqt aapke aage koi aankhein utha ke nahin khada ho sakta tha. To phir kya hua? Yeh to nahin, human beings to wahi, usi structure ke saath, usi brain ki ability ke saath, usi muscles ke saath, woh paida ho rahe hain continuously. To woh kahan gaye? Phir aisa to nahin hum keh sakte ke yahan par koi inferior kisam ki paidaish honi shuru ho gayi hai, ke yaar bade bandon ki ek taang badhi, ek taang chhoti hai, is wajah se yeh ho nahin sakte. Aisa nahin hai. But being a Muslim, hamare religion mein yeh saari cheezein hain na, like jhoot nahin bolna,

corruption, rishwat, these are all the things. For example, non-Muslims, these are all the things that are considered wrong by non-Muslims too. We have the proper teachings of this, that you don't want to do this, that you don't want to do this, that you don't want to do this. But we do that. This has got nothing to do with religion. But China is in your neighbour. They follow no religion. They are atheists. Wahan par sazayein dekhein, aap kis nature ki sazayein milti hain, bade bade generals ko, bade bade politicians ko, koi meeting ke andar agar uski aankh lag gayi hai, to usko saza-e-maut ho gayi hai. I mean jo morality ya jo ethics hai, uska taaluq religion se zyada aapki

matlab, this is not exactly linked with the DNA as well. Aapki tarbiyat kahan se shuru hoti hai? Ghar se shuru hoti hai na? To hum openly to nahin kabhi keh sakte hain ke agar bade hum ko koi galat kaam sikha rahe hain, to hum unko blame nahin karte hain, lekin bade bhi insaan hain, unse badon ne unko kya sikhaya? Kuchh unhon ne filter out kiya, hum tak pahunchaya. Kuchh humne filter out kiya, apni young generation tak pahunchaya. I mean humein insaan banne ki zaroorat hai pehle. Aur jinke paas ethics ho, jinke paas strong moral grounds ho, strong moral standing ho, answerable ho, accountability ho.

Not because they fear Allah, but because they fear themselves. Apne aap se bhi ek khauf aana chahiye, ke maine yeh galat kaam kiya, yeh maine chori kiya, mere upar bhi ek burden hona chahiye. Hamare religious, uski baat karein, to humne to saari cheezein Allah par chhodi hain, ke chalo yaar, Allah ki marzi hogi, ya aise ho gaya, agar koi haadsa ho gaya to Allah ki marzi, agar koi building gir gayi to Allah ki marzi, agar koi zalzala aa gaya to Allah ki marzi. Bhai, Allah ki marzi theek hai, sab cheezon mein woh badshah hai, uski marzi chalti hai. Un logon ke ghar bhi to hain na, jinke ghar nahin girte. Japan mein unhon ne aisi buildings bana di hain jin mein shocks lage hue hain, to itna zalzala duniya mein sab se zyada Japan mein aata hai, to wahan pe log zalzale se nahin

mar rahe. I mean Allah ki marzi to nahin hogi ke bandon ko tabah kar de aur woh unko maar de. Allah ki marzi yeh hogi ke aapko usne itna achha brain, itni achhi body, itni achhi senses, itni achhi saakht mein usne paida kiya hai, to aap usko utilise kyun nahin karte hain? Jaise hum kuchh din pehle baat kar rahe the, ke hamare yahan pe bada common hai, ke jab marta hai to gareeb marta hai, jab ghar girta hai to gareeb ka girta hai, jab sailaab aata hai to gareeb ka ghar beh jata hai, zalzala aata hai to gareeb ka ghar toot jata hai. To bhai, aap ko saza milni chahiye. Kyun? Aap kar sakte the. Pakka ghar bana sakte the, agar aap mehnat karte, agar aap theek direction mein kaam karte. Agar aap faaltu cheezon mein time zaya na karte, agar aap lambi taan

ke na sote rehte, aap ghar banate, mehnat karte. Aap hi mein se kuchh logon ne, kisi ne nikal ke koi mulk se bahar chala gaya, kisi ne yahan par mehnat ki, usne apna ghar pakka kar liya, usko to some extent, they are enjoying the security, protection. Isi tarah se, agar aap rules ko violate kar rahe hain aur uske baad aap kehte hain ke why there is a punishment, so there has to be a punishment. And religion is not to tell you about the morality. All religions say this. It is a common base. If it is divine laws, Allah has sent it, it is common.

Even, even those religions which are not called divine, or maybe the human invention. Unke andar bhi morality and ethics or clarity, woh isi tarah ki hai ke objective kya hai, ke insaan ki abaadi, peace ke saath, harmony ke saath, apne masail ko hal karne ki ahliyat ke saath zinda rahe, taaki ye progress kar sakein, aage badh sakein, achhi zindagi guzaar sakein. This is the only objective of all the governments, of all the religions, of all the creeds in the world. Pakistan's literacy rate is 63%, which is lowest in South Asia. So what do you think, ke hamari jo policies hain, woh is tarah ki nahin hain, ya jo parents hain, woh khud nahin bachon ko padha rahe? Padhoge likhoge banoge nawab,
